A rich departure from the house's usual sparkling identity.

wines.name: Cervo Rosso, Colli Altotiberini
wines.backstory: Blasi Cantina farms the Upper Tiber Valley in Umbria, a stretch of countryside making wine since the 1700s under the old Bertanzi Counts' estate. Founded in 2004 by Anna and Mauro Blasi, the winery replanted the vineyards and restored the historic cellar beneath Palazzo Bertanzi. This Colli Altotiberini red blends Sangiovese with Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot, a house style built on that same land.
